title: Bormann alive in Argentina, cashing checks via Chase

tellings.quote: And as late as the 1960s Martin Borman is cashing checks written in his own name through Chase JP Morgan Chase in >> Buenos Iris.

plain: Martin Bormann, a top Nazi official, escaped to Argentina after the Second World War and was still alive in the 1960s, cashing checks in his own name through the American bank Chase in Buenos Aires. A researcher named Jason Jorjani says so on Michels' show without naming a source, also mentioning Argentina's leader of the time, Juan Perón. If true, it would mean a senior Nazi lived openly for decades with help from a major Western bank.
